summary: Lists all recipes in an 8-column table with name, category, time, difficulty, servings, calories, rating and a favorite button. Users can search by recipe name, filter by category, sort by time, mark favorites, and click recipe names to view details.
mobileIssues: 8-column table is too wide for a phone screen
ingredients tooltip appears only on mouse hover, phones have no hover
sorting by time cannot be verified by a test, only the order can change
suggestedObligations: typing 'Sarma' in the 'Pretraga' field shows only recipes with 'Sarma' in the name
clicking the 'Deserti' button in 'Kategorija' shows only recipes in that category
with no recipes matching the search, the screen shows 'Nema recepata za zadatu pretragu'
clicking the star icon in the 'Omiljeni' column toggles the favorite state of that recipe

summary: Shows a list of categories on the left side with recipe counts. When a category is selected, a detail panel on the right shows recipes in that category with their time, difficulty, and links to view details.
mobileIssues: category list and recipe detail are side-by-side columns, which do not fit on a phone screen
suggestedObligations: the 'Recepti' button shows 'Recepti' with a count of all categories
clicking a category button displays that category's name and its recipes on the right
when no category is selected, the right panel shows 'Izaberite kategoriju'
when a category has no recipes, the right panel shows 'U ovoj kategoriji nema recepata'

summary: A form to add items to a shopping list, with a table showing items as rows with checkboxes and names. Users can add items by filling the field and clicking 'Dodaj' or pressing Enter, check items as bought, and clear all bought items.
mobileIssues: two-column table with checkboxes in the first column and item names in the second column may need adjustment for phone layout
suggestedObligations: filling 'Namirnica' with 'Mleko' and clicking 'Dodaj' adds the item to the list
a checkbox in a row marks the item as bought and the 'Kupljeno' counter increases
after checking items and clicking 'Obriši kupljene', only unchecked items remain
with no items in the list, the screen shows 'Lista za kupovinu je prazna'
pressing Enter in the 'Namirnica' field also adds the item (same as clicking 'Dodaj')

summary: Shows all favorite recipes in a three-column card grid with recipe name, metadata (time, difficulty, calories), and a favorite button. Users can click recipe names to view details or click the button to unfavorite recipes.
mobileIssues: three-column card grid layout is too wide for a phone screen
suggestedObligations: when no recipes are marked as favorite, the screen shows 'Nemate omiljenih recepata'
favorite recipes are displayed as cards with their name, time, difficulty and calories
clicking a recipe name navigates to that recipe's detail page
clicking the 'Ukloni iz omiljenih' button removes the recipe from favorites and hides it

summary: Shows a recipe's full details with category, time, difficulty, rating, and calories. The left panel has ingredients (scalable by servings) with an option to add all to the shopping list. The right panel shows preparation steps. Users can adjust servings and see an ingredient list scaled accordingly.
mobileIssues: ingredients and steps are in two columns side by side, which does not fit on a phone screen
suggestedObligations: the page shows the recipe name as a heading with category, time, difficulty, rating and calories
increasing 'Porcije' scales all ingredient amounts and updates the display
decreasing 'Porcije' to 1 disables the 'Smanji porcije' button
clicking 'Dodaj sastojke u listu za kupovinu' adds all scaled ingredients and shows 'Sastojci su dodati u listu za kupovinu'
clicking 'Nazad na recepte' navigates back to the recipe list
